rule: Code behaviour and tests are never management authorization.
verification_scope: Automated provenance (governance_test.go, with full git history): every commit named in an item exists and is an ancestor of the tested HEAD, the path exists in that commit, and the item's exact anchor text occurs in that historical file version (first commit named). This shows the text was in the repository at that commit. It does NOT authenticate who wrote or approved it, does not prove that the fact summary is a complete or correct reading, and does not verify anything outside git (GitHub threads, owner statements, negative claims). No item is independently authenticated.

provenance_levels.TEXT_AT_COMMIT_VERIFIED: commit, ancestry, path-at-commit and anchor checked by automation
provenance_levels.NOT_VERIFIED: no reliable anchor; only path existence on the current tree and commit syntax are checked
